title: Causative and reciprocal
summary: Make someone do something, or have it done, with the causative (*güldürmek, okatmak, turuzmak*; *Saçymy kesdirdim*), say who you got to do it (*Kakama kitap aldyrdym*), talk about doing things to each other with the reciprocal and *biri-biri* (*görüşmek, düşünişmek, biri-birine kömek etmek*), and make verbs from nouns and adjectives (*dostlaşmak, azalmak, gaharlanmak*).
canDo: Say what made you laugh, cry or wake up
Talk about having things done: a haircut, a repair, a new dress
Say who you got to do something for you
Say what people do to each other or together
Understand and use verbs made from nouns and adjectives
